! Game text
| '''Front (frozen) side'''<br />This is a Dark Side card and {{Errata hl|1=does not count toward your deck limit. Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. Deploys to Death Star II: Throne Room only at start of game as a frozen captive if Bring Him Before Me on table and Your Destiny is suspended; otherwise place out of play. For remainder of game, may not be placed in Reserve Deck. Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize}} is a persona of Luke only while on table. While this side up, Bring Him Before Me may not flip. May not be escorted. Flip this card if Vader present and not escorting a captive. Place out of play if released or about to leave table.<br />'''Back side'''<br />Immediately 'thaw' Luke (Luke is {{Errata hl|1=a}} non-frozen captive escorted by Vader). While this side up, subtracts 3 from attempts to cross Luke over (even while a captive). Place out of play if released or about to leave table. || '''Front (frozen) side'''<br />{{Errata hl|1=Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize}} is a Dark Side card and is a persona of Luke only while on table{{Errata hl|1=. Plays only during start of game by revealing from outside your deck if Your Destiny is on table and suspended; deploy to Throne Room as a frozen captive. If not revealed, place under your Starting Effect}}. While this side up, Bring Him Before Me may not flip. May not be escorted. Flip this card if Vader {{Errata hl|1=here}} and not escorting a captive. Place out of play if released or about to leave table.<br />'''Back side'''<br />Immediately 'thaw' Luke (Luke is non-frozen{{Errata hl|1=, captured, and seized}} by Vader). While this side up, subtracts 3 from attempts to cross Luke over (even while a captive). Place out of play if released or about to leave table.
